body:
Part of #2390.

## Problem

Even with chat events reaching the controller, the renderer has no path to show a remote agent in `ChatView`. Every chat surface assumes the agent is local and calls local IPC with the agent id.

## Established (origin/main 91da2bc6)

- `AgentRuntimePane.tsx:97-98`, `:203`, `:226` exclude remote projects (see #2391).
- `chatStore.ts:895-907` is the single seam the chat UI goes through: `loadTranscript`, `applyEvent`, `send`, `interrupt`, `respondPermission`, `answerQuestion`, `setLevel`, `setModel`. Each calls `window.clubhouse.chat.*` with the agent id. `initChatEventListener` (`chatStore.ts:1126-1127`) subscribes only to local `chat.onEvent`.
- `useAgentRuntimeInfo` asks main `chat.getAgentRuntime(agent.id, ...)` (`AgentRuntimePane.tsx:122`), which only knows local runtimes. For remote agents the controller should use `executionMode` from the snapshot (`annex-server.ts:540`) instead.
- Other local-only calls made by chat surfaces (from a grep of `window.clubhouse.*` under `features/agents/chat`): `chat.listSessions`, `chat.readTranscript` (ChatHistory), `chat.stageAttachment`, `chat.readMedia`, `chat.mediaAction`, `chat.listCheckpoints`, `chat.getChanges`, `chat.getRuntimeSettings`, `git.info`, `git.branchLog`, `git.branchChanges`, `git.branchFilePatch`, `git.githubRepo(dirPath)`. The git and checkpoint calls take satellite paths or ids that mean nothing on the controller.
- `SettingsCard.tsx:171-173` already special-cases remote agents and resolves the satellite name, so a remote-aware details panel has precedent.
- The "Needs you" list already includes remote agents (`ChromeSidebar.tsx:420-423`, `treeModel.ts:94` `selectRemoteNeedsAttention`), and opening a row switches host and opens the agent (`ChromeSidebar.tsx:473-486`). Today that lands on the blank terminal.

## Proposed approach

- Store remote chat state in `chatStore` under the namespaced agent id (`remote||<sat>||<id>`), fed by the `chat:event` and backfill from #2392. `applyEvent` already keys by `event.agentId`, so the annex consumer rewrites the id before applying.
- Give the store's actions a small backend switch: local ids go to `window.clubhouse.chat.*`, remote ids go to `window.clubhouse.annexClient.chat*` (routes added in #2395, #2396 and #2397). Components keep calling the store.
- `useAgentRuntimeInfo`: for remote agents derive `{ chat, live }` from `agent.executionMode` and `agent.status`; no IPC.
- First cut hides what has no remote route yet: checkpoints / revert, Changes review, git cards, Chat / Terminal switch. Each hidden control is listed in the PR so later children can turn them on.
- ChatHistory for remote agents uses the remote sessions/transcript routes from #2392.
- Header shows the satellite name so it is clear the session runs elsewhere.

## Acceptance criteria

- A remote chat agent renders in `ChatView` in the main pane, popout and canvas card, showing backfilled history and live streaming.
- Opening it from Needs you shows the pending permission or question (answering is #2396).
- ChatHistory lists the remote agent's sessions and opens a past transcript.
- No remote agent id reaches a local `window.clubhouse.chat.*` or `git.*` call (unit test on the store backend switch).
- Satellite disconnect shows the existing `SatelliteDisconnectedOverlay`; reconnect backfills without duplicates.
- Controls with no remote route are hidden, not shown disabled without explanation.

## Dependencies

- #2392 (chat:event forwarding and transcript backfill).
- Replaces the interim placeholder from #2391.
title: [MEDIUM] Render remote chat agents in ChatView on the controller
